text:
Tara (Sales): Hey team — FintechCorp just sent over a SIG/CAIQ + custom security questionnaire. Link: https://drive.redwood/FintechCorp/sec-q-2025.pdf. They need answers for an exec review on Mon (5 business days). Can someone own intake and give an ETA? :alarm_clock:

Sam (Security): @Tara assigning to security intake. Quick Q: will Fintech accept redacted answers for infra details? Also do we already have a current SIG/CAIQ snapshot?

Tara (Sales): They said they prefer full answers but might accept redactions for non-prod endpoints. I'll confirm. Timeline is firm — exec meeting is Apr 10.

Lina (Compliance): I can take primary on this one. ETA: draft responses in 3 business days if I get dataflow + hosted endpoints. Need product to confirm where PII resides. @Alex can you share scope? :white_check_mark:

Alex (Solutions): Copy. POC will be limited to our hosted API (routed via demo-gw). Fintech will hit /v1/generate and embeddings endpoints. They're not requesting pen test yet but could ask. Sample payload and rate expectations below:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/demo/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
```
Will provide sample payloads and expected TPS by EOD.

Ben (Infra): Dataflow diagram here: https://confluence.redwood/infra/fintech-dataflow. Logs for demo are in elastic index `elasticsearch-logs-prod`. We keep retention 90d for prod logs. If they need raw logs we need an NDA + redaction.

Sam (Security): Thanks. I created ticket SEC-789 in our intake queue and attached the questionnaire. JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-789. Assigning to @Lina; tagging `priority:high` and `customer:FintechCorp`. Please update SEC-789 with any infra links or screenshots.

Lina (Compliance): Checklist I'm using: 1) SIG/CAIQ export, 2) custom questionnaire answers, 3) infra/dataflow confirmation, 4) redaction plan (if requested), 5) legal/contract if pen-test asked. @Alex please paste sample payloads + any env names.

Alex (Solutions): Pasted sample payloads in SEC-789 comment and linked demo env: demo.fintech.redwood (staging). TPS expected ~10-20 for POC. No PII in prompts for demo, but production plan might include hashed user ids.

Ben (Infra): Note: staging has separate logs/retention (30d). Production (if later) will have PII controls — encryption at rest + KMS. I'll add a short note in the JIRA about S3 bucket names and KMS key aliases.

Tara (Sales): This is great. Customer asked specifically about SOC2 scope and if we have attestation docs — can someone drop the current link?

Sam (Security): SOC2 cert link added to SEC-789. Also attaching latest SIG snapshot (v2025-03). If Fintech requests CAIQ export, we can supply the XML.

risk-bot: Created VDR folder `FintechCorp - Security Intake` and uploaded initial questionnaire. VDR: https://vdr.redwood/fintechcorp/

Lina (Compliance): Draft answers uploaded to SEC-789 as `draft-v1.pdf`. Need product sign-off on Q12 (data retention) and Q27 (access controls).@Ben can you confirm bucket-level IAM?

Ben (Infra): Confirmed — buckets use least-privilege roles, cross-account read is disabled by default. Added IAM policy link in SEC-789 comment.

Lina (Compliance): Ok setting internal target: finish final answers by 2025-04-04 so Sales can review before exec meeting. Will ping product owners if no replies by EOD tomorrow. :spiral_calendar:

Tara (Sales): Thanks @Lina and team — please flag any blockers ASAP. I told the customer we'd keep them updated twice this week.

Sam (Security): If they request a pen-test or access to logs we'll escalate to Legal for a contract amendment. For now holding at `info-only`.

Lina (Compliance): Update 2025-04-02 09:12 — Draft submitted to Sales for review (see SEC-789). Waiting on product sign-off for Q12/Q27.

Tara (Sales): Received. I'll get product to sign off today. Will update customer after I get confirmation. :thumbsup: 

Lina (Compliance): Final answers submitted to VDR and SEC-789. Marking intake as `awaiting-customer-ack`.

risk-bot: SEC-789 status changed -> "answers-submitted". Reminder: close ticket after customer ack.

Tara (Sales): Awesome — customer notified and appreciated the speed. Will follow up if they ask for more detail.

Sam (Security): Great job team. If anything else pops up @Tara, loop me in and I'll triage.

Lina (Compliance): Closing out from my side; will reopen if customer asks for clarifications.
